decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That this consent is granted for a limited period of three years from the date of this consent. At the end of three years after the date of this consent, it shall be removed.

Condition : 2 - No advertisement shall be displayed without the consent of the owner of the site (this includes lands or buildings where the advertisement is displayed), nor the permission of any other person with an interest in the land entitled to give permission.

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed that would endanger anyone using the highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military) or would obscure or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal, or aid to navigation by water or air. It also prohibits the siting or display of an advertisement that would hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance (such as closed circuit television cameras) or for measuring the speed of any vehicle (speed cameras or other speed-measuring devices).

Condition : 4 - All advertisements displayed, and any land or building used for the purpose of its display, shall be maintained in a reasonably clean and tidy condition so that it does not impair the visual amenity of the site.
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding used for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition so that it does not endanger the public.

Condition : 6 - Where any advertisement is required to be removed, the removal shall leave the site in a safe condition that does not endanger the public, and in a reasonably clean and tidy condition so that it does not impair the site's visual amenity.
Condition : 7 - The maximum luminance for the advertisements shall not exceed 600cd/m2.

Condition : 8 - The displays on the all the panels shall be static only, with no moving or apparently moving images, devices, wording or emblems, and shall not depict any images that resemble road signs or traffic signals unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - The advertisements displayed on each panel shall not change more frequently than once in a 24-hour period, and this change shall be at a time of day when traffic flows are low.
description: Installation of 1 X part illuminated flexface curved sign (6600mm X 4700mm) (sonic logo) to the building
